tool_args.rationale: The pilot supports a coupled transient and the specified siphon-memory branch has five unknown parameters, while only five rows are available. The extra fine trajectory batch is the only listed probe that can add relevant identification data; do not fit yet.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled siphon-memory RK4 model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five parameters are not reliably identifiable from only five rows; branch guidance explicitly calls for additional trajectory data before fitting.
The guidance recommends it, but it is not listed in the available probe cost menu and cannot be selected.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not address the parameter-identifiability gap.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit Kelvin-Voigt creep, damped oscillator, or stretched-exponential alternatives
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These do not capture the supplied coupled-transient branch guidance and are not justified over the indicated multi-tree mechanism.
